q01.question: Where is what I say stored?
q01.answer: It's stored encrypted, tied to your account. No one else can read it.

q02.question: What happens to my past diaries if I cancel?
q02.answer: You can still read them, but you can't add new entries. To remove everything, use Delete account on /me.

q03.question: Are my conversations used to train AI?
q03.answer: No. Your diaries are never used to train AI models. See our Privacy Policy for details.

q04.question: Can I use it offline?
q04.answer: You can browse some pages offline, but recording and summarizing need an internet connection.

q05.question: Can I use the same account on multiple devices?
q05.answer: Yes. Sign in with your email and password on any device to reach the same diaries.
